headline: UPDATE: Sensex +780pts to 78,750, Nifty tops 24,590 as crude-relief rally extends on Iran de-escalation
gist: Follow-through on the Trump-Iran/OPEC+ crude story: Nifty 24,592.25 (+0.86%, day range 24,515-24,602), Sensex 78,752.35 (+0.84%, range 78,497-78,895), Bank Nifty 57,833.25 (+0.99%). All three above VWAP, upper half of range. WTI 79.49 (-6.12%), still below VWAP 79.60. Gold 4,112.50 (+0.13%) and Silver 58.13 (+0.60%) both faded off session highs, now below VWAP.

headline: UPDATE: WTI extends slide to fresh session low $78.43 (-6.1%) as Iran-Hormuz de-escalation, OPEC+ Sept hike deepen demand-concern selling
gist: WTI printed a new session low of $78.43 (day range $78.43-81.30), below VWAP $79.76, extending the morning Iran/OPEC+ driven selloff as soft China demand data added pressure. Last $79.55.

headline: US ISM manufacturing PMI beats at 55.6% (est. 54.0%), best since 2022; factory jobs expand for first time in ~3 yrs
gist: Stronger-than-expected July ISM manufacturing print firmed the dollar and pulled gold/silver off session highs. Gold $4,092.60 (-0.35%, range $4,074.00-4,145.50), Silver $57.59 (-0.35%, range $56.71-58.88), both below VWAP.

headline: UPDATE: WTI rebounds off $78.43 low to $80.07 as Iran's repeated denial of US talks revives supply-risk doubts
gist: Crude clawed back from the session low of $78.43 to $80.07 (-5.43%) as Iran's Foreign Ministry again denied any US talks were scheduled (only Oman-mediated Hormuz-routing discussions), reviving supply-risk doubts even as OPEC+'s Sept output hike still weighs. Above VWAP $79.51, day range $78.43-81.30; buyers defended 78.8-79.0 twice. Gold $4,090.40 (-0.40%), Silver $57.87 (+0.14%), Nat gas $2.76 (+0.47%) — all little changed since the 21:08 IST brief.

headline: Nifty, Bank Nifty open lower despite record Wall Street highs; RBI verdict due Wed
gist: First brief of the day (overnight/premarket). GIFT Nifty had signalled a flat open, but cash Nifty opened down to 24,605.95 (-0.68%, day range 24,589.85-24,703.90) and Bank Nifty to 57,853.35 (-0.68%, range 57,651.15-58,068.95), both above VWAP but lower half of range, as caution builds into RBI's Aug 5 policy call (consensus: hold at 5.25%). Sensex feed delayed on Yahoo (last live print 78,639.03, +0.70%, from ~15:30 IST Mon).

headline: Wall Street closes at highs Monday (S&P +1.48%, Dow record +1.32%, Nasdaq +2.1%) on Iran de-escalation; Asia fails to follow, Nikkei -1.0%
gist: S&P 500 +1.48% to 7,600.50, Dow +1.32% to a record 53,178.41, Nasdaq +2.1% to 25,913.9 Monday as US-Iran de-escalation and falling oil lifted risk appetite. Asia didn't follow through Tuesday: Nikkei 225 -1.0%, MSCI Asia ex-Japan -0.5% on AI-trade jitters (Kospi volatility), capping the read-through into India's open.

headline: UPDATE: WTI extends bounce further to $81.03 as Iran-talks-denial supply-risk story continues; gold/silver firm ahead of US jobs data
gist: WTI $81.03 (+0.86% vs prev close $80.34), day range $79.62-81.28, above VWAP $80.49, upper half of range — continuing the overnight recovery off Monday's Iran/OPEC+ selloff low; demand defended 79.85-80.20, supply capping 81.05-81.28. Gold $4,112.00 (+0.53%), Silver $58.90 (+1.80%, outperforming gold, near session high) — both above VWAP as a softer dollar builds into today's US NFP/JOLTS releases. Nat gas flat/soft at $2.76 (-0.61%), below VWAP, no fresh driver.

headline: Bharti Airtel, ONGC headline ~135 companies reporting Q1 FY27 results today
gist: Bharti Airtel (Nifty's #2 weight, ~6.3%) and ONGC lead a slate of ~135 companies due to report June-quarter (Q1 FY27) results today, including BSE, Pidilite, Marico, Nykaa, Bharti Hexacom, Godrej Properties, MCX, UNO Minda, Deepak Nitrite. Results due post-market; no numbers out yet as of this brief.
